question: Should authenticated identity binding remain exclusively under `import hydrate-profiles`, or should `init --account` become a second permanent command surface with fresh-database-only semantics?
rationale: Both implementations are technically possible, but the choice sets a lasting CLI and upgrade contract that cannot be resolved safely from tests alone.

options.title: Extend hydration command
options.body: Move exact OAuth2 selection to `import hydrate-profiles --account <username>` with an account-only mode, preserving one explicit identity-binding workflow.

options.title: Keep init selection
options.body: Retain `init --account`, explicitly approve the parallel command surface, and document and test its behavior for databases created before the seed marker existed.

recommendation.title: Extend hydration command
recommendation.body: Move exact OAuth2 selection to `import hydrate-profiles --account <username>` with an account-only mode, preserving one explicit identity-binding workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the clearest available authority for the permanent CLI and upgrade contract.
